data.name: Karee
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Karee means 'pure, clear, bright'. This name was given to the goddess Persephone when she was abducted and taken to the underworld. It represents the idea of renewal and rebirth, as well as the strength and purity of the spirit.
